Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
DOC-0055 2026-10-05
RETROSPECTIVE — Priority Proposals Changed Faster Than
Their Reasons
Date: 2026-10-05
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
Recorder: PERSON-0004, TEAM-0004
What happened During a hydraulics agenda discussion, proposed priority
labels were recopied while their original reasons remained on separate desk
notes. The later agenda made the suggestions look like a settled sequence of
decisions. ISSUE-0086 and TASK-0280 locate the paperwork example; this
account does not state a record's priority.
What helped The documentation clerk retained the dated source notes.
Comparing the reasons exposed that the proposals addressed different
scheduling concerns. The chair could then ask which concern needed a
decision instead of treating the newest label as the most persuasive.
What changes Use reason-before-rank on every proposed change. State the
scheduling concern and consequence of delay before the proposed label. Keep
the submitting role, date, and reason together in the proposal history, and
distinguish that history from the source-record field.
When a proposal changes, preserve the earlier entry and explain what new
administrative consideration prompted the revision. Recopying a rank
without its reason must not make it appear that a decision has already
occurred. The receiving coordinator should be able to find the rationale
without asking the outgoing desk to reconstruct the conversation.
Follow-up PERSON-0004 will review the proposal-history layout with the
documentation clerk on 2026-10-07. The chair will check that the next agenda
identifies the decision sought and retains the original reasons beside the
alternatives.
D. Worker 0004
Demo Worker 0004, Demo Team 04
